eyebrow: Between raw tables and a report
code:
# trips and zones: two separate tables.
# No defined relationship. No agreed business definitions.
#
# A semantic model adds exactly that --
# relationships, measures, friendly names.
caption: So a report author queries concepts, not raw columns.

code:
Relationship: trips.PULocationID -> zones.LocationID
Measure: Total Revenue = SUM(trips[fare_amount])
Measure: Trip Count = COUNTROWS(trips)
caption: A relationship = join(), defined once. A measure = SUM(), defined once, used everywhere.
